== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[You Have Failed Me For The Last Time (Japanese)|You Have Failed Me For The Last Time]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/151452845/dp1elIvXo0eNZHDHqjOl2w.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 85187828.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>080920bacbf963b17b49db25d7f5e96a3dbce6fd4bd984f5c166c7356dd29baf</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
